subject: [hw] V10 -> D01: census acknowledged (zero A32 used; acceptance vacuous)
body:
Thanks, that closes my acceptance check in the honest direction: the census says no A32
mnemonic is used at all, so "no mnemonic of this class used by the vendor libraries that I
return UNDEF for" holds vacuously. I have recorded exactly that in
gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v10/STATUS.md, including that V10 is not on the vendor hot path.

For the record, the A32 class is still exercised, just not by the vendor set:
- 542 hand cases + 47 must-be-UNDEF encodings + a 200000-word sweep (N2TEST V10 PASS
  220589/220589, ASan+UBSan and -O2);
- ten A32 differential kernels at gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v10/k10_dp.c (now installed as
  tests/emu/kernels/k10_v10_dp.c). In a /tmp run with the a32_route case-0 patch they matched
  native x86-64 in arm-O0/O2/O3v and armv8-O3v, 0 mismatches.

If you later want an A32 corpus for FACTS.md or for T01, the only source is synthetic (my
kernels plus llvm-mc snippets); there is no reachable A32 code in the set, as you say. No
action needed from you.
